name: Catering Service
description: A comprehensive catering and event hospitality template designed for off-premise caterers, corporate dining specialists, wedding banquet providers, and private chef services. Structured around advance pre-orders, per-head (per-guest) pricing models, scalable headcount calculations, event date scheduling, and bespoke custom menu consultation workflows for gatherings of any size.

sections.name: Appetizer & Starter Packages
sections.description: Passed hors d'oeuvres, chilled finger foods, and interactive appetizer stations designed for cocktail receptions, arrival mixers, and pre-dinner social hours. This section exists to help event organizers select opening culinary bites that stimulate appetite and facilitate guest mingling before formal seating, priced either per head or by fixed platter quantities.

subSections.name: Cold Canapés
subSections.description: Delicate, chilled one-bite canapés, savory tartlets, crostini, blinis, and fresh seafood spoons crafted for room-temperature standing receptions.

subSections.name: Hot Passed Hors d'Oeuvres
subSections.description: Warm bite-sized skewers, artisanal sliders, arancini, mini quiches, and gourmet empanadas circulated hot by service staff during cocktail hours.

subSections.name: Dip & Crudite Stations
subSections.description: Self-service grazing displays, artisanal charcuterie and regional cheese boards, crisp market vegetable crudités, and Mediterranean hummus and mezze spreads.

timeBehavior.note: Appetizer packages must be pre-ordered at least 72 hours prior to the event date to ensure fresh preparation.

sections.name: Main Course Packages
sections.description: Substantial meal packages serving as the culinary centerpiece of banquets, weddings, corporate galas, and festive dinners. This section exists to provide structured entrée offerings across multiple service formats (plated, buffet, family-style, or live-fire BBQ), giving event hosts per-person pricing clarity, protein choice combinations, and integrated starch and vegetable accompaniments.

subSections.name: Plated Dinner Options
subSections.description: Formal multi-course plated dinners individually portioned, garnished, and served to seated guests at designated tables by dedicated waitstaff.

subSections.name: Buffet Stations
subSections.description: Double-sided self-service hot and chilled banquet stations featuring stainless chafing dishes, carved-meat carving tables, and themed food bars.

subSections.name: Family-Style Platters
subSections.description: Communal dining experience featuring generous multi-portion platters placed at the center of dining tables for interactive guest sharing.

subSections.name: BBQ & Grill Stations
subSections.description: Live on-site flame grilling and slow-smoked barbecue stations serving tender smoked meats, charred vegetables, artisanal buns, and hearty regional sides.

sections.name: Dessert Packages
sections.description: Artisanal sweet displays, formal plated dessert courses, and customized ceremonial cake services designed to provide a memorable conclusion to banquet dining. This section exists to handle both self-service dessert bars and seated sweet courses, including cake cutting, portioning logistics, and sweet dietary alternatives.

subSections.name: Dessert Tables
subSections.description: Visually stunning sweet grazing tables featuring miniature shooters, macarons, gourmet brownies, fruit tartlets, and petite cheesecakes.

subSections.name: Plated Desserts

This section exists to simplify drink provisioning through predictable per-guest, time-allotted packages while addressing licensing, glassware rentals, bar staff, and responsible alcohol hospitality.

subSections.description: Infused citrus waters, artisanal lemonades, iced botanical teas, craft sodas, and handcrafted mocktails for daytime and family events.

sections.name: Custom Menu Consultation

This section exists as an interactive intake form allowing prospective clients to submit guest counts, budgetary parameters, dietary restrictions, and creative culinary visions directly to the executive chef.

sections.name: Seasonal & Holiday Menus

This section exists to provide ready-to-order seasonal feasts (such as Thanksgiving roasts, Winter Holiday banquets, Spring Garden gatherings, and Summer Solstice BBQs) with signature holiday trimmings and fixed per-guest package rates.

subSections.name: Autumn Harvest Gatherings

systemFeatures.name: Mandatory Advance Pre-Order
systemFeatures.description: Enforces advance pre-ordering requirements for all catering packages with configurable minimum lead times, order confirmation deadlines, and guest count finalization cutoffs.

systemFeatures.name: Event Date & Delivery Slot Picker
systemFeatures.description: Requires customers to select their verified event date, preferred arrival window, and venue access schedule before finalizing any catering package booking.

systemFeatures.name: Guest Count & Dynamic Headcount Calculator
systemFeatures.description: Dynamically scales package pricing, portion allocations, staff requirements, and tableware counts based on customer-entered headcount.

systemFeatures.name: Comprehensive Allergen & Dietary Indicators
systemFeatures.description: Displays clear allergen icons, dietary compatibility badges (Gluten-Free, Dairy-Free, Nut-Free, Halal, Kosher, Vegan, Vegetarian), and kitchen cross-contamination warnings across all catering menus.

systemFeatures.name: Custom Menu Consultation & Inquiry Intake
systemFeatures.description: Enables interactive consultation booking, bespoke menu planning questionnaires, and direct chef communication for personalized event proposals.
